sources.loanRatePct: Mid-market green EV secured rate, November 2026 (RBA cash rate 4.85% from 4 Nov 2026). Best advertised green loan 5.79% (Money.com.au, 17 Nov 2026); Bank Australia 6.29%.
sources.leaseRatePct: Competitive novated comparison rate was 6.5-7.5% in mid-2026; cash rate up 50bp since, so 8.0%.
sources.electricityCentsPerKwh: 2026-27 Victorian Default Offer flat rates, Melbourne zones 25.96 to 27.47 c/kWh (ESC final decision, May 2026, via Canstar).
sources.petrolCentsPerLitre: Unleaded 91, November 2026: national average 234.3c on 7 Nov, five-city average 232.7c week to 4 Nov (ACCC via IBTimes); wholesale easing. Only used for plug-in hybrids.
sources.otherRunningCostsAnnual: VIC rego $958.80 (2026-27 metro, incl. TAC) plus servicing and tyres. ZLEV discount ended 1 Jan 2026.
sources.opportunityRatePct: High-interest savings, November 2026: ordinary accounts above 5%, bonus rates to 6% (cash rate 4.85%).
